question: RX 7900 XTX ROCm Qwen3 Flash Attention performance

sources.title: Qwen3.8 Flash CIRU 7900XTX + Strix - GitHub
sources.snippet: Run Qwen3.8 Flash across an RX 7900 XTX 24GB and Strix Halo with 128GB RAM, with 262144-token target context. This Linux/ROCm runtime was measured on a Bosgame M5 using an M.2-to-OCuLink adapter and Minisforum DEG1 dock.
